title: Viking orbiter image of the Face on Mars

tellings.quote: the mid 1970s the Viking orbiters sent back an image that caused quite a stir a mile long structure that resembled a human face

plain: In the mid 1970s, one of the Viking orbiters, NASA probes sent to circle Mars, sent back a photo of the Cydonia region that showed what looked like a human face: a structure about a mile long. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, and says the image "caused quite a stir" because it raised the question of whether someone had once built on Mars.
